title: kate-text: tell when two ranges share a scalar
summary: intersects is true when two half-open ranges share a scalar. A touch at one end shares none. An empty range shares none. The test goes in the existing offset tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: pub fn intersects(&self, other: CharRange) -> bool

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: offset.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add intersects on impl CharRange. The body is one comparison: self.start.max(other.start) < self.end.min(other.end). Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch new, start, end, len, is_empty, or contains. The existing test new_orders_endpoints_and_contains_is_half_open stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test ranges_touch_without_overlapping checks CharRange::new of Offset(1) and Offset(4) against Offset(3) and Offset(5) is true. Offset(1) and Offset(4) against Offset(4) and Offset(6) is false. Offset(3) and Offset(3) against Offset(1) and Offset(4) is false. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: offset::tests::ranges_touch_without_overlapping
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because intersects does not exist. After the change a shared scalar is true. A touch at the end is false. An empty range inside another range is false.
